about: Places where a player or a check found a broken street. scripts/check-road-flatness.mjs reports the worst of every measure within `radius` metres of each (default 40), so a fix can be seen to hold and a regression shows by name.

places.name: Na Veselí over the underpass
places.what: a dip of several metres and a wall across: the underpass's kerbs pulled the street down (sunk kerbs, fixed 2026-11-08)

places.name: náměstí Hrdinů over Táborská
places.what: the street sank to the road in the underpass (sunk kerbs, fixed 2026-11-08); a wall terrace's bump on the side street remains

places.name: Kongresové centrum
places.what: the crossing by the congress centre, two levels in one survey polygon

places.name: Kongresová, ridge across
places.what: a ridge of about 0.9 m across the street

places.name: Legerova
places.what: a stretch the map and the LiDAR share, next to one they don't

places.name: U tržnice
places.what: a lean of 44 % and a 1.4 m ridge

places.name: Washingtonova
places.what: the map off the street's height

places.name: Na Topolce
places.what: a retaining wall along the street

places.name: Závišova
places.what: the map a flat 0.4 m above the street

places.name: Dobříšská, north end
places.what: the LiDAR and the surface model disagree

places.name: náměstí Míru
places.what: a pit players drove into: kerbs surveyed 21 m under the square (SUNK, fixed in October)

places.name: Strahovský tunel under Strahov
places.what: the tunnel can't be driven through from Smíchov: each tube's halves met in a ramp of 103 % (tunnels solved like bridges, fixed 2026-11-18)

places.name: Wilsonova by Hlavní nádraží
places.what: a wall round the road: the station hall under it was solid across the lanes (streets on a building's roof, fixed 2026-11-18)

places.name: Wilsonova at Bulhar
places.what: the magistrála completely broken: the viaduct's outline a blank slab on a level of its own over both carriageways

places.name: Dvorecký most at Strakonická
places.what: the junction and the way onto the bridge from the west: the bridge's west half, missing from IPR's model, runs evenly 1.5 m under Strakonická
